# @sandlada/opencode-ask

Read-only **Ask** agent for [OpenCode v2](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/).
It answers questions without modifying the project, and appears alongside
`Build` / `Plan` in the TUI agent cycle (`Shift+Tab`, `Ctrl+X A`, `/agents`).

- `edit *` → `deny` (never creates, edits, or deletes files)
- `shell` → a read-only allowlist runs without approval — git
  status/log/diff/show, ls / dir / rg / cat / head / tail / tree, tool
  `--version`, and `pnpm test` (running the project's tests is ask mode's job)
- anything else still pops one approval, then answers — `git commit`, `rm`,
  `npm install`, other test commands and builds (they execute project code),
  and any command not on the allowlist
- guard rules drop chained, redirected, and egress commands back to `ask`:
  compound commands (`&&`, `||`, `;`, `&`) and commands containing `>` or
  `curl` / `ssh` / `rsync` / `Invoke-WebRequest` / … prompt even when they
  start with an allowlisted program, so a read or a test run can never be
  turned into a write, an exfiltration, or a smuggled mutation silently
- `subagent` → `deny` except `explore` (can't escalate to a writing agent)
- `question` → `allow`
- Model-call guard: when the session agent is `ask`, the `write` / `edit` /
  `patch` tools are stripped from the request and a read-only reminder is
  appended to the system prompt.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add @sandlada/opencode-ask
```

Or manually in `opencode.jsonc`:

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": ["@sandlada/opencode-ask"]
}
```

Then restart the service (or the TUI) and run `/agents` — `ask` shows up as a
primary agent.

## Usage

Switch to `Ask` and ask anything read-only:

```text
how does auth work in this project?
are tests green?
```

If you ask for a code change, it explains the plan and asks you to switch back
to `Build` (or `Plan`) instead of editing.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
```

Verify locally without publishing:

```sh
mkdir /tmp/ask-check
printf '{ "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": ["%s"] }' "$PWD" > /tmp/ask-check/opencode.jsonc
cd /tmp/ask-check && opencode debug agents
```

`ask` should appear with `mode: primary`, `edit: deny`, `shell` resolving to
`allow` for inspection commands (e.g. `git status`, `pnpm test`) and `ask` for
everything else.
